column1: # Revised again at 20:45, after the 120-minute soak settled the burn rate at 0.78 BZZ/hr on the
# uploader and 0.64 on the gateway, FLAT across four independent 30-minute windows.
# ⛔ The 2.62 BZZ/hr I cut the night down on was wrong. It came from an arm sitting whose cost is
# mostly per-broadcast setup, not per minute. What is left in the chequebooks buys about seven more
# hours of CONTINUOUS broadcast, not the two I thought.
# So the four-hour soak that was dropped goes back on, at the GOP a broadcaster actually sends. At
# 2.0s the segment peaks at 2.133s, so #EXT-X-TARGETDURATION is 3 and the stall penalty caps at 3.0s
# instead of 1.0s. Whether that ratchet bites over hours has never been watched, and the 120-minute
# run at 0.5s is the control taken the same night on the same box.
